releaseNotes: Fixed intermittent bug when deleting zones
All Pulse effects now have both a loops and duration param that will clear when done
Added color params to all 8x8 matrix explosions
Fixed intermittent crash with clear all zones button in Companion
Added flip support for Pulse matrix devices in user installed them upside down
All 8x32 matrix effects will now scale on a 8x48 matrix
Added graphic equalizer effects fo Pulse devices for Spotify and Last.fm widgets
Changed to improved, single pixel font for Pixelcade Pulse dot matrix display
Smooth scrolling for the Pulse dot matrix display
Added zone based flood commands
Batocera VPinball fixes
Pulse 7Segment, Dot Matrix, and miniLCD startup init fixs
Added char support to 7segment api and perf improvement
Pulse - New LED strip and matrix effects for the Planes Overhead and Earthquake widgets
Pulse - Improved the majority of the console LED strip animations, added additional mame games, and added a set for RCade menu items
Pulse - bug fixes for zone setups

Fix: 7-segment and dot matrix no longer blank when pixelweb restarts (e.g. returning from Visual Pinball) -- a display that's already running keeps showing its content, and commands to the Pulse displays are no longer dropped during a re-init. A full re-init still happens after a power cycle or USB unplug
Fix: the mini LCD no longer blanks between updates -- new lines overwrite the old ones instead of clearing the screen first
Faster 7-segment/dot matrix re-init (power-up test patterns only shown at power-up)
Fixed intermittent bug when deleting zones
All Pulse effects now have both a loops and duration param that will clear when done
Added color params to all 8x8 matrix explosions
Fixed intermittent crash with clear all zones button in Companion
